The process
01
Ingestion — Regulation PDF and official EBA templates parsed
02
Annotation — Domain expert maps each article to generators and edges. One-time per regulation.
03
Ground Truth — Official template parsed — every reporting cell catalogued
04
Generation — Rule-based engine expands annotations with institution profile
05
Validation — Generated obligations vs ground truth — precision and recall computed
ObligaIConfidential · May 2026
Key principles
01
Deterministic
Same inputs always produce the same obligations
02
Traceable
Every obligation references its source article
03
Auditable
Every output verifiable against the official EBA template
04
No ML
Rule-based engine — no probabilistic component, no invented obligations
05
Institution-Specific
Tailored to entity structure, currencies, and regulatory scope
06
Incremental
Regulatory amendments regenerate only the affected obligations
